title: CRM-Agent-Bench: Benchmarking Tool-Using Agents in Stateful Enterprise Environments
abstract: arXiv:2610.32004v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deploying language agents in real applications demands more than the right answer: an agent must execute a multi-step business process correctly, follow domain-specific rules, and interact with a user across a dialogue, where the gap between saying and doing is the gap between a satisfied customer and a real loss. We argue that a deployable-agent benchmark should jointly assess four facets: the outcome an agent reaches, the trajectory it takes, its operational viability, and its policy compliance. Customer relationship management (CRM), where mutable records meet operational rules and consequential effects, exercises all four. We introduce CRM-Agent-Bench, an execution-grounded benchmark of 555 stateful, multi-turn tasks across nine business domains and 36 capability tags. translated_title: CRM-Agent-Bench：面向有状态企业环境中工具使用型智能体的基准测试
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.32004v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：在真实应用中部署语言智能体，仅仅给出正确答案是远远不够的：智能体必须正确执行多步骤业务流程、遵守领域特定规则，并在跨轮对话中与用户持续交互——“说到”与“做到”之间的差距，正是客户满意与真实损失之间的差距。我们认为，一个面向可部署智能体的基准测试应联合评估四个维度：智能体达成的结果、所走的轨迹、其运营可行性以及政策合规性。客户关系管理（CRM）领域兼具可变记录、运营规则和重大后果影响，恰好能同时检验这四个方面。我们提出了 CRM-Agent-Bench，这是一个以真实执行为基础的基准测试，包含 555 个有状态的多轮任务，覆盖九个业务领域和 36 个能力标签。每个任务都提供一份任务专属的可执行契约，该契约源自对动作、参数、执行顺序、响应、目标状态和受保护状态的检查；成功意味着……
tldr: 该论文提出 CRM-Agent-Bench，一个包含 555 个有状态多轮任务、覆盖九大业务领域的执行型基准测试，从结果、轨迹、运营可行性和政策合规四个维度联合评估语言智能体在真实企业 CRM 环境中执行多步骤业务流程的真实能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CRM-Agent-Bench, an execution-grounded benchmark of 555 stateful multi-turn tasks across nine business domains that jointly evaluates language agents on outcome, trajectory, operational viability, and policy compliance when executing real multi-step business processes in enterprise CRM environments.
